title: Submit your artist story
description: Complete the redesigned five-section A-List form and submit an initial application.

steps.caption: 1. A-List Submission starts with your artist identity. Select every role that applies.
2. Tell the team about your experience behind the decks and in the studio.

target.label: How long have you been DJing?

actions.value: 8 years of clubs and community radio

target.label: How long have you been producing? (optional)

actions.value: 5 years of jungle and drum & bass

steps.caption: 3. Add optional highlights from your scene: events, supporting artists and record labels.
4. Link a social profile. Follower counts are optional, self-reported and unverified.
5. Add anything else, review your answers and submit your story to the cre8 team.

actions.value: Monthly radio resident supporting emerging producers.
